name: io.github.theinfluencecompany/realtime-avatar
title: Realtime Avatar
description: Read your Realtime Avatar avatars, credit balance and session bill from a coding agent.

environmentVariables.name: REALTIME_AVATAR_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Realtime Avatar API key (tic_test_ or tic_live_). A free sandbox key: https://realtimeavatar.ai/signup

environmentVariables.name: REALTIME_AVATAR_ALLOW_WRITES
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to enable write tools (avatar creation, clip library, start_call). start_call bills per second and refuses tic_live_ keys.
